description: Issue tracker ticket creation with milestone/label triage and an attended-mode confirmation gate

eval_dimensions.name: Step 4e confirmation gate
eval_dimensions.description: Attended filing confirms the proposed title, milestone and labels through AskUserQuestion, never plain text (GH-1704)

eval_dimensions.name: Attended vs unattended detection
eval_dimensions.description: Unattended mode (Skill() from an orchestrator with an active task list) skips the gate and still never files bare

eval_dimensions.name: Never file bare
eval_dimensions.description: Every ticket carries a milestone or the needs-triage label (GH-1102)

evals.name: Attended filing confirms the triage
evals.description: A user typing /dev10x:ticket-create sees the proposed title, milestone and labels and must confirm before filing
evals.input: /dev10x:ticket-create Fix the retry loop that drops the last poll result

assertions.signal: Reads open milestones and labels before proposing
Step 4e confirmation uses AskUserQuestion, not plain text
First option is 'Create as proposed (Recommended)', followed by edit and abort options
No ticket is created before the user answers the gate

evals.name: Unattended filing skips the gate
evals.description: Invoked via Skill() from an orchestrator with an active task list, the skill files with the triaged milestone and labels without asking
evals.input: Skill(dev10x:ticket-create) from dev10x:work-on while a plan task is in_progress

assertions.signal: No AskUserQuestion confirmation widget fires in unattended mode
The created ticket carries a milestone or the needs-triage label

should_trigger: Create a ticket for the flaky payment test
